STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_HAND_CRANK.title: Hand Crank
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_HAND_CRANK.descripti: At the start of the first turn of each combat, choose to gain [blue]{Stress}[/blue] [gold]Stress[/gold], or gain [blue]{Wood}[/blue] [gold]Plank[/gold] and [blue]{Stone}[/blue] [gold]Cobblestone[/gold].
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_HAND_CRANK.flavor: Crank it up before anything else gets going.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_MAID_BACKPACK.title: Maid's Backpack
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_MAID_BACKPACK.descri: When picked up, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Potion Slots[/gold] and fill every empty slot with a random food.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_MAID_BACKPACK.flavor: A small backpack with a huge capacity, stuffed with all kinds of food the owner prepared.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_DEPLOYER.title: Deployer
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_DEPLOYER.description: At the start of the first turn of each combat, choose to gain [blue]{Stress}[/blue] [gold]Stress[/gold], or gain [blue]{Wood}[/blue] [gold]Plank[/gold], [blue]{Stone}[/blue] [gold]Cobblestone[/gold] and [blue]{Iron}[/blue] [gold]Iron Ingot[/gold].
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_DEPLOYER.flavor: An upgraded Hand Crank with more impressive results.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_SOPHISTICATED_BACKPA:

STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_TOTEMOF_UNDYING.desc: When you would be killed, prevent it, heal [blue]{Heal}%[/blue] of your Max HP, gain [blue]10[/blue] Regeneration and [blue]15[/blue] Block. (Once)
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_TOTEMOF_UNDYING.flav: A redemption beyond life and death. WineFox cannot fall yet.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_CREATIVE_MOTOR.title: Creative Motor
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_CREATIVE_MOTOR.descr: The first time you lose [gold]Stress[/gold] each turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Stress[/gold].
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_CREATIVE_MOTOR.flavo: It can spin all by itself!
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_ORANGE_TIGER_CAKE.de: When picked up, gain [blue]8[/blue] Max HP, [blue]2[/blue] random foods, [blue]1[/blue] card reward set, and [blue]50[/blue] Gold.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_ORANGE_TIGER_CAKE.fl: Wow! A golden legend, meow! Delicious little cake.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_NIMBLE_FABRIC.title: Nimble Fabric
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_NIMBLE_FABRIC.descri: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Buffer[/gold].
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_CAT_BOMB.title: Cat Bomb
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_CAT_BOMB.description: At the end of turn [blue]3[/blue], deal [blue]30[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_ELYTRA.title: Elytra
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_ELYTRA.description: When choosing the next room, you have [blue]{Rooms}[/blue] chances to ignore the current route. Replenish [blue]1[/blue] charge after defeating an Elite enemy.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_OILY_BEAN_CURD.title: Oily Bean Curd
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_OILY_BEAN_CURD.descr: Every [blue]5[/blue] Foods consumed, gain [blue]2[/blue] Max HP.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_OILY_BEAN_CURD.flavo: No fox can resist oily bean curd! None!
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_WOUND_RIME_BLADE.des: Enemies cannot heal or gain Block. At the start of your turn, apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to a random enemy.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_WOUND_RIME_BLADE.fla: A cursed blade stained with lingering blood.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_BLEEDING_HEART.title: Bleeding Heart
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_BLEEDING_HEART.descr: After each combat, heal [blue]2[/blue] HP. After defeating an Elite enemy, gain [blue]7[/blue] Max HP.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_BLEEDING_HEART.flavo: Drinking in blood, it seems to still be beating.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_FLOW_CORE.title: Flow Core
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_FLOW_CORE.descriptio: Every [blue]3[/blue] turns, gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy and heal [blue]1[/blue] HP. You cannot lose more than [blue]15[/blue] HP in a single turn.
Reflect attack damage you take back to the attacker.
Malice returns to its source in the end.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_ANCHOR_CORE.title: Anchor Core
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_ANCHOR_CORE.descript: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Artifact[/gold].
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_RINGOF_BURNING_BLOOD: Increase attack damage based on the percentage of HP you have lost, up to [blue]50%[/blue].
Inviting all to share in death.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_BONUS_CHEST.title: Bonus Chest
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_BONUS_CHEST.descript: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{Iron}[/blue] [gold]Iron Ingots[/gold].
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_BONUS_CHEST.flavor: Open it, and inside are supplies enough to turn the situation around.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_MAID_BEACON.title: Shrine Lantern
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_MAID_BEACON.descript: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy and draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_MAID_BEACON.flavor: A stone lantern in the shrine garden, lighting the way for the fox that walks at night.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_SHRINE.title: Shrine
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_SHRINE.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]3[/blue] Energy and draw [blue]3[/blue] cards.
STS2_WINE_FOX_RELIC_SHRINE.flavor: The stone lantern has become a shrine, its blessings overflowing for the fox that walks onward.
